scope: Semantic review of retiring the broken private account settings/profile route and removing user-facing navigation, search, redirect, and route-policy pointers to it.
decisions: Deleted the /settings page module so /settings and /settings?tab=profile no longer resolve to a broken account surface; public Star creator profiles at /profile/<handle> remain unchanged.

Removed Profile and Settings & Preferences entries from the desktop header, avatar menu, mobile drawer, mobile bottom tabs, footer, and recent-route catalog; billing and image-library destinations remain available.
Removed the legacy developer-tab redirect and the dead settings route classification so no compatibility rule silently revives the retired destination.
Reconciled current navigation and image-boundary maintainer guides while preserving dated historical audit evidence as historical rather than current instructions.

validation.production_build: npm run build passed; the generated route manifest contains 163 pages and no /settings route.
validation.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit passed after the production build regenerated route types.
validation.lint: npm run lint passed with zero errors and eight pre-existing warnings.
validation.ux_detector: Impeccable deterministic detector returned no findings for Navigation, MobileBottomNav, Footer, or footer styles.
validation.security_navigation: npm run test:image:security passed 55/55; node --import tsx --test scripts/test-url-navigation.ts passed 5/5.
validation.public_asset_scan: Source and rebuilt public/browser asset scans contain no /settings or /settings?tab=profile navigation references; /teams/settings remains an unrelated team-admin destination.
validation.documentation_sync: npm run docs:sync passed; affected Images, access, client-efficiency, and billing domains were reviewed explicitly.

limits: No live deployment or production browser acceptance is implied.
The underlying account-profile data schema remains intact for a future supported account surface; this change retires only the broken page and its navigation exposure.
